definitions.table: Original evaluator metrics; mean and sample SD across five seeds. RMSE is computed per run before averaging.
definitions.energy_score: Float64 per-origin verification of cross-sectional N-dimensional ES, averaged over H=5 leads; pdist sum divided by S(S-1), S=256.
definitions.paired_direction: FrozenGraph minus Full. Positive losses favor Full; negative graph-IoU difference favors Full.
definitions.paired_unit: Match training seeds and exact within-fold origins/targets; seed-average origin differences keep all assets/leads grouped.
definitions.selection: Independent fold/variant selection on seed 1 validation, frozen globally before final test; equal nominal four slots, three unique FrozenGraph candidates.
definitions.study_identity: Selected Full models belong to this separate control study; original benchmark/theory checkpoints are unchanged.
definitions.state: Future leads 1..5 only; graph support strict abs(A)>0.05 off diagonal, empty union zero.
definitions.inference: Descriptive by default; optional temporal percentile intervals, no p-values or significance labels.
